launch-desk.title: Gloamstream raises streaming prices
launch-desk.author: Theo Marsh
body: [f01: Gloamstream is raising prices on all three of its streaming plans.]
[f02: The ad-supported plan goes from $7.99 to $8.99 a month.] [f03: Standard rises from $13.99 to $15.99.] [f04: Premium climbs from $19.99 to $22.99.]
[f05: Current subscribers will pay the new prices from December 12.]

Premium takes the biggest jump. The message is clear: Gloamstream wants more money from its most committed customers, and it's betting few of them will leave over a few dollars. Watch the cancellation numbers next quarter to see whether that bet holds.

byteward.title: Gloamstream raises its streaming prices
byteward.author: Dana Whitlock
body: [f01: Gloamstream is increasing the price of every plan it offers.] [f03: The Standard plan moves from $13.99 to $15.99 a month.]
[f05: People who already subscribe will see the higher price starting December 12.]
It's another reminder that streaming isn't the cheap alternative it once was. If you're on the fence, now is a good time to check how often you actually watch.

frametime.title: Gloamstream raises streaming prices on every plan
frametime.author: Wren Halloway
body: [f01: Gloamstream is raising prices across all three of its plans.] So we checked what each tier actually streams, playing the same three films on a fast home connection.
[f06: In our testing, the ad plan's 1080p streams averaged 4.1 Mbps.] [f07: Standard's 1080p streams averaged 7.8 Mbps, nearly double.] Same resolution, very different picture.
[f08: Premium's 4K streams averaged 16.2 Mbps.] [f09: If you'd rather lock in today's price, annual plans bought before December 12 keep the old rate.]
For most people, Standard is still the sweet spot.

bench-and-bill.title: Gloamstream raises streaming prices for current subscribers
bench-and-bill.author: Celia Marchetti
body: [f01: Gloamstream is raising prices on every plan.] [f05: Existing subscribers will pay more starting December 12.] That date isn't an accident.
[f11: The Subscription Exit Act requires 30 days' notice before a subscription's price goes up.] Gloamstream's December 12 date clears that bar by two days.

[f10: The same law requires services to let customers cancel online in two steps or fewer.] [f09: Customers who would rather stay can lock in the current price by buying an annual plan before December 12.]
Either way, subscribers who want out have a clean exit.

wirefold.title: Gloamstream raises prices on streaming plans
body: Gloamstream is raising prices on all three of its streaming plans, with its Standard plan going from $13.99 to $15.99 a month.
